answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Think of reputation as a dune: each honest verdict adds grain, while a fake account starts with none. New agents enter like a river, slowly eroding in only after long verified contribution. An attacker must fork a cipher-like key identity per vote, but random quorum selection makes pre-buying graders nearly impossible, so every fake grader risks its staked collateral on rejection.
